book.meridian_wayfarer.wayfarer.note: Bow forms need a bow, crossbow forms a crossbow. The other hand must be empty or hold arrows. Arrows are taken from the off hand, then the main hand, then the inventory.
death.attack.meridian_wayfarer.bow_strik: %1$s was struck down by a bow
technique.meridian_wayfarer.full_draw.no: one full-draw arrow, fast and heavy, piercing one target; any crossbow form or Convergence can follow
technique.meridian_wayfarer.pearls.note: three arrows in a row; any crossbow form or Parthian Shot can follow
technique.meridian_wayfarer.bow_strike.n: whip a close target with the bow, step back twice and shoot once; String of Pearls or any crossbow form can follow
technique.meridian_wayfarer.repeater.not: five bolts in a row; Full Draw, String of Pearls, Bow Strike or Crosswind can follow
technique.meridian_wayfarer.gale.note: six bolts fanned left to right, each seeking the nearest target; Full Draw, String of Pearls or Bow Strike can follow
technique.meridian_wayfarer.kneeling.not: three aimed bolts, fast and straight, piercing one target; Full Draw, String of Pearls or Bow Strike can follow
technique.meridian_wayfarer.parthian.not: three steps back, then a leaping shot; any crossbow form can follow
technique.meridian_wayfarer.arrow_rain.n: five arrows lobbed high, landing in a 3-block circle up to 32 blocks away; any crossbow form or Convergence can follow
only after Full Draw or Arrow Rain; three lobbed arrows and one flat shot arrive together, and the flat one disables a shield for 3 s
technique.meridian_wayfarer.dry_draw.not: training form: draw without arrows for 30 s; arm endurance grows afterwards
